mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_exchange_returns (after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, ship_address, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{afterSaleId}, #{returnWay}, #{returnTimeSlot}, #{shipAddress}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, return_courier, return_tracking_number, ship_address, pickup_at, pickup_no, ship_courier, ship_tracking_number, ship_at, review_at, return_at, exchange_at, exchanged_at, rejected_at, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM after_sale_exchange_returns WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sale_exchange_returns SET ship_courier = #{shipCourier}, ship_tracking_number = #{shipTrackingNumber}, ship_at = #{shipAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} AND is_deleted = 0
